en.quote: Create and modernize 25 million high-productivity jobs by 2020.
en.head: The 2020 count was 21.95 million, short of 25 million.
en.body: The decree set a target of creating and modernising 25 million high-productivity jobs by 2020. Rosstat data used by FinExpertiza put the 2020 count at 21.95 million, about 3.05 million short. The statistical measure classifies jobs using a pay threshold rather than measuring each worker’s output directly.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 596, “On Long-Term State Economic Policy”

osrc.t: RBC, FinExpertiza analysis of Rosstat data
